answer_1.quote: We evaluate decoding methods across a variety of tasks, including summarization (CNN/DailyMail, XSUM), translation (WMT22), code generation (HumanEval, MBPP), instruction following (AlpacaEval), factual knowledge (FActScore), and open‑ended text generation (Book, Wikinews, Wikitext).
answer_1.outputs: Generated text or code produced by the LLMs

answer_2.quote: We measure performance with RougeL for summarization, BLEU for translation, MAUVE for open‑ended generation, pass@1 accuracy for code generation, and FActScore for factual knowledge.

answer_3.quote: We use AlpacaEval to compare model performances, using pairwise Win Rate against the reference model, Text-Davinci-003.
